g.title: G
cluster_micro
cluster_meso
cluster_macro

p8_meso_layer_post_trough_incidence_ratio → p8_micro_post_trough_exposure_flag downward A layer with elevated post-trough attributed exposure incidence increases the probability that an individual active in that layer experiences a new exposure transition after the city-wide infectious trough.

p8_meso_layer_post_trough_incidence_ratio → p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio intra_scale Layer-specific post-trough resurgence can propagate into age-band post-trough exposure rates when those layers serve particular ages.

p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio → p8_micro_offset_from_infectious_trough downward When a band's post-trough incidence is much higher than at the trough, its exposures concentrate later in the resurgent phase, increasing the positive offset from the trough for individuals in that band.

p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio → p8_micro_post_trough_exposure_flag downward A higher band-level post-trough incidence ratio means exposure activity in that age band is elevated after the trough, raising the probability that an individual in the band has a post-trough exposure transition.

p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio → p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth upward Age bands with high post-trough exposure rates contribute disproportionately to new infections, increasing aggregate post-trough infectious growth.

p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio → p8_macro_resurgence_amplitude upward Age-selective post-trough increases in exposure rates add to the overall infectious pool, raising the observed resurgence amplitude.

p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth → p8_micro_post_trough_exposure_flag downward When city-wide infectious growth after the trough is stronger, individual exposure transitions are more likely to occur after the trough.

p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth → p8_meso_layer_post_trough_incidence_ratio downward Stronger post-trough infectious growth can raise layer-specific post-trough exposure incidence relative to the trough, increasing the layer rebound ratio.

p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth → p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio downward Post-trough growth can be age-selective, plausibly raising the after-versus-at-trough exposure hazard ratio in some age bands.

p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth → p8_macro_resurgence_amplitude intra_scale Sustained positive post-trough infectious growth can raise the maximum infectious count relative to the trough, increasing rebound amplitude.

p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth → p8_macro_resurgence_breadth intra_scale Broad post-trough growth can appear across multiple contact layers, increasing the share of layers with post-trough incidence increases.

p8_macro_resurgence_amplitude → p8_meso_layer_post_trough_incidence_ratio downward A larger citywide post-trough rebound implies stronger re-activation of transmission opportunities, which can differentially raise attributed exposure incidence in specific contact layers after the trough.

p8_macro_resurgence_amplitude → p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth intra_scale A larger post-trough rebound implies faster accumulation of infectious agents, so resurgence amplitude tracks positive post-trough growth.

p8_macro_trough_susceptible_depletion → p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio downward Greater susceptible depletion at the trough leaves fewer susceptible person-steps in each age band, reducing the post-trough rebound ratio of band exposure hazard relative to its trough value.
p8_macro_trough_susceptible_depletion → p8_macro_resurgence_amplitude intra_scale A larger susceptible share at the trough plausibly supports a larger post-trough infectious rebound.

p8_macro_resurgence_breadth → p8_micro_offset_from_infectious_trough downward Widespread resurgence extends post-trough exposure activity, so agents exposed during rebound tend to have larger positive offsets from the trough step.

p8_macro_resurgence_breadth → p8_micro_post_trough_exposure_flag downward Broader layer resurgence increases the overall post-trough exposure pressure, raising the probability that an individual new exposure occurs after the infectious trough.

p8_macro_resurgence_breadth → p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio downward When resurgence is broad across many layers, post-trough exposure activity is more widespread, raising band-specific post-trough incidence ratios relative to the trough.

N60 | p8_micro_offset_from_infectious_trough Agent exposure-step offset from the city infectious trough Scale: micro | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: o_i = t_i - t*, where t_i is the agent's first observed exposure step and t* is the observed step of minimum count of agents with infectious_i(t) = true within the run (earliest such step on ties); undefined when t_i is undefined or t* is undefined. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N61 | p8_micro_post_trough_exposure_flag Agent exposure transition after the infectious trough Scale: micro | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: R_i(t) = 1 if X_i(t) = 1 and t > t*; 0 if X_i(t) = 1 and t <= t*; undefined if X_i(t) = 0 or t* is undefined. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N62 | p8_meso_layer_post_trough_incidence_ratio Layer attributed-exposure rate ratio after versus at the trough Scale: meso | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: Phi_l = (mean over observed steps s > t* of lambda_l(s)) / lambda_l(t*), where lambda_l(s) is attributed layer exposure incidence per edge at step s; undefined when lambda_l(t*) = 0, is undefined, or no step after t* is observed. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N63 | p8_meso_band_post_trough_incidence_ratio Age-band exposure rate ratio after versus at the trough Scale: meso | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: Psi_b = (mean over observed steps s > t* of h_b(s)) / h_b(t*), with h_b the band exposure hazard per susceptible person-step; undefined when h_b(t*) = 0, is undefined, or no step after t* is observed. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N64 | p8_macro_post_trough_infectious_growth Mean post-trough log growth of infectious agents Scale: macro | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: g = mean over consecutive observed step pairs (s-1, s) with s > t*, I(s-1) > 0 and I(s) > 0 of ln(I(s)/I(s-1)), where I(s) is the count of agents with infectious_i(s) = true; undefined when no such pair exists. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N65 | p8_macro_resurgence_amplitude Post-trough rebound amplitude of infectious count Scale: macro | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: A = (max over observed steps s > t* of I(s)) / I(t*); undefined when I(t*) = 0 or no step after t* is observed. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N66 | p8_macro_trough_susceptible_depletion Susceptible share at the infectious trough Scale: macro | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: S(t*) = (number of agents i observed at t* with susceptible_i(t*) = true) / (number of agents observed at t*); undefined when t* is undefined or no agent is observed at t*. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}

N67 | p8_macro_resurgence_breadth Share of layers with post-trough incidence increase Scale: macro | Phenomenon: community_resurgence_after_decline Definition: B = (number of layers l with Phi_l defined and Phi_l > 1) / (number of layers l with Phi_l defined); undefined when no layer has a defined ratio. Execution: {'3249f90463154305aed53504106b3dae': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}
